D: A scientist accidentally shrinks his kids and the neighbours' kids to the size of ants.
P: Serve the snacks when the kids ride the ant.
S: Rice bubble treats pressed into a big ring mould (marshmallows melted with butter, cereal stirred through), one giant loop to share.
the one they sleep on overnight
Two big dark chocolate cookies sandwiched with a thick layer of vanilla buttercream (butter, icing sugar, vanilla), cut into wedges.
the backyard toy that becomes a shelter

Firm, bright fruit jelly blocks in red, yellow and blue, cut into bricks with little cream studs piped on top, ready to stack. Make 3 packets of different coloured jelly, each with half the usual water (about 250ml boiling water) plus 2 tsp extra powdered gelatine, so they set firm. Pour each into a separate lined 20cm square tin and chill 4 hours. Cut into 2 by 4cm bricks. Whip 150ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and pipe two rows of small dots on each brick as studs.
M: Juicy beef burgers grilled over coals with melted cheese, lettuce and tomato on toasted buns, with buttered corn on the cob and a crunchy green salad. Mix 800g beef mince with salt and pepper and shape into 4 patties. Grill over hot coals 4 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheese to each for the last minute. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes, turning, and brush with butter. Toss cos lettuce, cucumber and cherry tomatoes with a dressing of 3 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp vinegar and 1 tsp mustard. Toast 4 buns and fill with lettuce, tomato, patty and sauce.
Buttermilk pancake batter cooked as one huge pancake in a big pan, cut into wedges, butter and syrup.
W: camping out in the grass jungle
Toast marshmallows over a flame and squash them with squares of milk chocolate between two plain biscuits.
K: Fresh watermelon blitzed with lemon juice and sugar syrup, strained and topped with soda water over ice, with lemon wheels and mint. Blitz 800g seedless watermelon chunks until smooth and strain through a sieve into a jug. Stir in 120ml fresh lemon juice and 80ml sugar syrup. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour the watermelon lemonade two thirds of the way and top with soda water. Garnish with lemon wheels and mint.

s.how: Melt 60g butter with 250g marshmallows over low heat. Stir through 150g puffed rice cereal until coated. Press firmly into a greased ring mould and set for an hour. Turn out and cut into wedges at the table.

s.note: the one they sleep on overnight
s.how: Beat 100g soft butter with 200g icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla until fluffy. Spread thickly between two large dark chocolate cookies, about 20cm across, pressing gently. Chill 20 minutes and cut into wedges.

m.how: Whisk 300g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 tbsp sugar, 500ml buttermilk and 2 eggs. Pour into a large buttered pan over low heat, cover and cook 8 minutes, then flip with a plate and cook 5 more. Cut into wedges with butter and maple syrup.

w.note: camping out in the grass jungle
w.how: Toast 16 large marshmallows on skewers over a gas flame or under the grill until golden. Squash each between 2 plain biscuits with a square of milk chocolate (32 biscuits and 200g chocolate in total) and leave 30 seconds so the chocolate melts.

d.how: Blitz 800g seedless watermelon chunks until smooth and strain through a sieve into a jug. Stir in 120ml fresh lemon juice and 80ml sugar syrup. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour the watermelon lemonade two thirds of the way and top with soda water. Garnish with lemon wheels and mint.
